faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Havanese?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 7-13 lb (3-6 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Havanese?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Patellar luxation; Dental disease; Heart murmur screening needs. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Havanese at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Havanese default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
